# spec/contract/contract

`spec/contract/contract` — the entry to a contract: read its JSON, check
its values, and hand back the model of `spec/contract/types`.

How a downstream stage plugs in: load with `contractLoad`, which gives a
contract whose structure (`spec/contract/read`) and values
(`spec/contract/shape`) are already checked, so the stage reads the model's
fields without checking them again. A stage that judges a contract further
(coverage, quotes, solver bounds) is a gate: a top-level `CheckGate`,
`(ctx: CheckContext) => string[]`, reading the contract from `ctx.contract`
and returning one message per finding, registered in `checkGates` of
`spec/check` after the blocking shape gate. Expressions
are typed with `typeOf` from `spec/contract/typing`, and a contract is
written back with `contractWrite` from `spec/contract/write`, byte for byte
as `contracts/*.json` are.

Generated from [src/spec/contract/contract.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/contract/contract.ts).

## Declarations

### contractLoad

Reads a contract from its JSON text and checks its structure and values,
reporting every error rather than stopping at the first.

```ts
function contractLoad(text: string, source: string): Result<Contract, string[]>
```

the contract's JSON

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="source" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;Contract, string[]&gt;">

the contract, or every error, each as `<path>: <what was wanted>`

</scalar-field>

### contractLoadFile

Reads a contract file and checks it, as `contractLoad` does.

```ts
function contractLoadFile(path: string): Result<Contract, string[]>
```

<scalar-field name="path" type="string" required>

the contract file

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;Contract, string[]&gt;">

the contract, or every error; an unreadable file is one error

</scalar-field>
